title: Mystery airship phenomenon
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Mystery airship phenomenon, about late 1800s at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then suddenly at the same time you have the mystery airship phenomenon.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher and filmmaker, mentions the "mystery airship phenomenon": reports in the 1800s, in the United States and Europe, of strange flying craft seen in the sky at a time when nobody was supposed to have such machines. He brings it up as something that happened "at the same time" as other strange events he describes, and credits the idea to a UFO historian named Richard Dolan. If true, it would mean unknown craft were flying long before modern aircraft existed.
